definitions.explanation: An attitude of not caring about the outcome, doing things carelessly without effort or responsibility. Implies giving up on trying properly.

examples.japanese: {投|な}げやりな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{何|なに}もかも→何もかも：26777_nanimokamo⟧{投|な}げやりになってしまった。
examples.english: I got tired and became apathetic about everything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかなくて{投|な}げやりな{気持|きも}ちになった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}まされた→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧。
examples.english: When work wasn't going well I felt like giving up, but the people around me encouraged me.

notes:
{投|な}げやり describes an irresponsible, couldn't-care-less attitude. It comes from the image of throwing something away carelessly (⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ + ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {投|な}げやりな + noun: a half-hearted ~
- {投|な}げやり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become apathetic, to stop caring

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投|な}げやりな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a careless / couldn't-care-less attitude
- {投|な}げやりな⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧: an indifferent reply
- {投|な}げやりな⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧: a dismissive way of speaking
- {投|な}げやりな{気持|きも}ち: a feeling of apathy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いい{加減|かげん}→いい加減：09353_iikagen⟧: irresponsible, sloppy (broader range of carelessness)
- ⟦{無責任|むせきにん}→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧: irresponsible (more formal, focuses on lack of responsibility)
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unmotivated, lacking motivation
